title: Loombridge 2D Kids Mini-Game Verification Contract
description: PRODUCT-OWNED. A per-game description of the machine-checkable facts a 2D kids mini-game release must satisfy (required objects visible, UI inside the safe area, tap targets sized for the age band, a happy path that reaches a reward, clean frames). The S6 counterpart to a platformer feel profile. The runtime source of truth is `mcp-server/src/loombridge/minigame-profiles/validator.ts`; this JSON Schema documents the same contract. Key rules: states + requiredInFrame must be non-empty; checks.deterministic must enable >=1 CI-deciding check; gate/check names come from a closed vocabulary; a tap target below the age-band ergonomic floor is refused.

id.description: Stable mini-game id (lowercase kebab, starts with a letter), e.g. 'alphabet-pop'.

scenes.description: Unity scenes this mini-game lives in. Each must be an Assets/**.unity path with no '..' traversal or backslashes.

ageBand.description: Target age band; pins the ergonomic tap-target floor.

visualProfile.description: Target device aspect/orientation; drives safe-area and no-black-bars checks.

devices.description: OPTIONAL device-set override: a non-empty bracket of real resolutions to verify across. Absent = the visual profile's default device set. Each id is filename-safe and unique; aspect is derived from width/height.

requiredInFrame.description: Objects that MUST be visible (>=1). A contract that requires nothing visible verifies nothing.

allowedOffscreen.description: Objects explicitly allowed offscreen (must not also be requiredInFrame).

id.description: Filename-safe state id (lowercase alnum + -/_, no '@'). Used as the <state>.png stem and the logical half of a <state>@<device> key.

scene.description: If set, must be one of the declared scenes.

requiredInFrame.description: requiredInFrame object ids that must be visible in THIS state.

outcomeGated.description: The state is reached only by a game OUTCOME a read-only verifier can't drive (a win/reward on a re-randomizing game). NOT asserted; reported as outcome-gated, never a failure.

reached.description: Optional capture-time state-reached signal. Capture waits for this condition before screenshotting the state; timeout means no artifacts for this state and a not-captured/harness result.

inputResponse.description: Liveness for the input-response check: tapping `tap` must observably change >=1 `observe` object (text/visibility/appears). Both reference ids declared in the top-level object list; observe ids need NOT be visible at the start (an element that appears on tap is valid). Pick an outcome-INDEPENDENT response so it stays RNG-invariant. Declaring this without enabling the input-response check (or vice-versa) is refused.

maxOverflowFraction.description: How far required UI may exceed the safe area (fraction). 0 = strict.

safeAreaExempt.description: Object ids or scene paths the 'safe-area-sweep' check may leave outside the safe area (beyond the automatic full-frame-backdrop exemption). For the rare intentional edge element; the rule is 'only backgrounds may bleed'. A matched element that would fail is surfaced as a 'waived' note, never silent.

safeAreaBackground.description: uGUI decorative-background subtrees/patterns the 'safe-area-sweep' check exempts (sky/hill/cloud/sparkle Images that may sit outside the safe area). Each entry matches by exact path, ANCESTOR path ('/Canvas/Background' exempts all descendants), or trailing-'*' prefix glob ('/Canvas/Sparkle*'). Matched decoration is skipped silently (correctly-classified background, not a waived finding).

minSizeDp.description: Declared minimum tap-target edge length in dp. Must be >= the age-band floor (validator-enforced: 2-4=100, 3-5=80, 5-7=64, 8-12=48).

happyPath.description: Ordered state ids the happy path visits; must reference declared states and include a success_reward state.

artifactThresholds.description: Tolerances for the frame/visual artifact checks; each value is a fraction in [0,1].

containers.description: Background->content containment bindings for the 'background-fit' gate (required iff background-fit is enabled; a check that decides nothing is refused). A background card's rendered fill must cover >= minBgFillFraction of its layout rect; if any declared content is visible, the background must be present, visible, and pixel-graded.

background.description: Declared object id of the background card/panel (its rect bounds the measured region).

content.description: Declared object ids the background should envelop. If any is visible in a state, the background must be present, visible, and pixel-graded.

bgColor.description: Hex #RRGGBB of the background fill colour. Default #FFFFFF.

minBgFillFraction.description: Min fraction of the background rect its fill must cover. Default 0.6. A value of 0 is refused (it would make background-fit always pass).

backgroundLayers.description: World-space background-layer object locators for the 'background-coverage' and 'background-seam' gates (the sky/hill/ground sprites that must cover the camera's view and bleed cut edges at every device aspect). Required (non-empty) iff either gate is enabled.

backgroundCamera.description: The rendering camera locator for the 'background-coverage' and 'background-seam' gates, e.g. 'Scene:/Main Camera'. Required iff either gate is enabled.

deterministic.description: CI-deciding checks. Must enable at least one. Names from the closed deterministic vocabulary.

advisory.description: Advisory/VLM checks; never hard-fail CI by default. Names from the closed advisory vocabulary.

baseline.description: OPTIONAL approved baseline reference. Baseline regression is a later S6 slice; this is the shape only.

masks.description: Object ids whose region is masked from baseline diffing. Each must be a declared requiredInFrame/allowedOffscreen id (validator-enforced cross-reference).

stateSignal.description: OPTIONAL declared game state-signal that `minigame next` threads into the printed `trace record --observe` command (--state-signal <path>:<Component>:<property>) so a multi-screen/gesture game can phase-align each gesture on the game's phase. `locator` is a BARE hierarchy path: NO scene prefix and NO ':' (the CLI parses --state-signal on ':').

locator.description: Bare hierarchy path, e.g. '/Canvas/GameManager' — no scene prefix, no ':' (the --state-signal delimiter).

property.description: Property the phase is read from, e.g. 'phase'.

expected.description: Expected value; JSON shape is preserved and mapped 1:1 to runtime.wait_for_condition.

timeoutMs.description: Optional bounded wait budget in milliseconds.
